name: What plumbing upgrades are common during a bathroom remodel?

mainEntity.name: What plumbing upgrades are common during a bathroom remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common plumbing upgrades during a bathroom remodel include replacing old pipes with PEX or copper for better water flow and durability, installing new fixtures like low-flow toilets and showerheads, and relocating drains or supply lines for a new layout. You might also consider adding luxury features such as a tankless water heater, a bidet, or a steam shower, which require specific plumbing considerations. Our team evaluates your existing plumbing system to recommend the most suitable upgrades for your project's scope and your home's needs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Common upgrades include pipe replacement, new fixture installation, drain/supply line relocation, and luxury feature additions.
